name: Niss
source:
"Her practicality may come off as distant, but her actions reveal kindness and a strong moral compass."

Niss is an elven scout/huntress on the trail of a terrible beast which she has been hunting for years. She does not sleep, but does get weary, and has a powerful sense of smell.
